name: LB Group Co., Ltd.
blurb: LB Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese company primarily engaged in the production and sale of titanium dioxide and other chemical products. It is one of the leading titanium dioxide manufacturers in China, with a strong market position in the domestic and international markets. The company also produces iron oxide pigments and other related products. LB Group focuses on technological innovation and capacity expansion to maintain its competitive edge.
recent: In the past 30 days, LB Group's stock has shown moderate volatility amid broader market trends. No major earnings releases or significant corporate announcements have been reported. The stock price has been influenced by fluctuations in raw material costs and demand for titanium dioxide.
